headline.purpose: Page title h1. Appears once per page. Always inside an amber chip wrapper.

title.purpose: Table headers, nav labels, stat chips. Structural weight layer.

body.purpose: Table row content, general text. Max 65ch line length.

label.purpose: Stats, counts, pagination numbers, filter controls.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Nav links, search bar, stat chips. Confirms element is distinct from background.

shadows.name: shadow-md
shadows.purpose: Table, pagination, detail cards. Marks a contained surface region.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Row hover, color shifts, small state changes.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Below this: width switches from min(70%,Xpx) to 92vw.

components.name: Nav Active
components.description: Active page tab. Shiso Green fill, white text.
components.css: .ds-nav-active, .ds-nav-inactive { text-decoration: none; padding: 7px 20px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: Poppins, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.14); transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), background-color 160ms ease; display: inline-block; margin-right: 8px; } .ds-nav-active { background-color: #34a44c; color: #fff; } .ds-nav-active:hover { background-color: #287d3b; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-nav-inactive { background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.92); color: #1c1208; } .ds-nav-inactive:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.22); } .ds-nav-active:active, .ds-nav-inactive:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible, .ds-nav-inactive:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #34a44c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Full-width search field with green focus ring.
components.css: .ds-search { width: 100%; padding: 10px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.92); font-family: Poppins, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: #1c1208; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.14); transition: box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-search:focus { outline: none; background-color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(52,164,76,0.3), 0 4px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.22); }

components.name: Table
components.description: The product. Amber headers, alternating rows, hover tint.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.92); border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.22); font-family: Poppins, sans-serif; } .ds-table th { background-color: #dcb67d; padding: 14px 16px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; text-align: center; color: #1c1208; } .ds-table td { padding: 10px 16px; text-align: center; color: #1c1208; } .ds-table tbody tr { transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background-color: rgba(220,182,125,0.18); } .ds-table tr:nth-child(even) { background-color: rgba(220,182,125,0.85); } .ds-table tr:nth-child(even):hover { background-color: rgba(220,182,125,1); } .ds-table a { text-decoration: none; color: #1c1208; font-weight: 500; transition: color 150ms ease; } .ds-table a:hover { color: #287d3b; } .ds-table a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #34a44c; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Pagination Bar
components.description: Compact pill with active green page indicator.
components.html: «123»
components.css: .ds-pagination { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 3px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.92); border-radius: 10px; padding: 5px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.14); width: fit-content; } .ds-pagination a { color: #1c1208; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 36px; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 6px; font-family: Poppins, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-pagination a:hover:not(.active) { background-color: rgba(220,182,125,0.18); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-pagination a:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-pagination a.active { background-color: #34a44c; color: #fff; } .ds-pagination a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #34a44c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Amber Chip (Stat / Heading)
components.description: Amber background chip used for h1, total count, and filter bar.
components.css: .ds-amber-chip { background-color: #dcb67d; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 20px; font-family: Poppins, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.375rem; text-align: center; color: #1c1208; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.14); } .ds-amber-chip span { color: #34a44c; }

narrative.overview:
Every entry in this list is a trophy. The interface exists to honor that collection: warm, personal, yours alone. The amber tones evoke the worn spines of manga volumes stacked on a shelf, the green marks something alive and in progress. Behind it all, a dark background image bleeds through surfaces, grounding the UI in the world of anime it tracks.

The system is simultaneously dense and celebratory, precise and tactile. The table is the product; everything else exists to serve it. Surfaces are translucent to let the world beneath breathe. Color is structural, not decorative: amber identifies, green activates, dark lacquer anchors.

This is not a SaaS dashboard. It is not a media catalog with carousels and hero images. It is a handwritten list made legible by software.
keyCharacteristics: Amber is structure, not accent — it appears in every header and even row
Green is reserved for active states and actions only
Translucent surfaces reveal the background without obscuring content
One font family, four weights — hierarchy through weight contrast alone
Every interaction confirms itself (scale, color shift, focus ring)

rules.name: The One-Green Rule
rules.body: Shiso Green appears only on active/selected states and focus rings. Never use it for decorative purposes. Its scarcity is what makes it mean 'here.'

rules.name: The Amber-as-Structure Rule
rules.body: Tatami Gold is not an accent. It is a structural color that occupies table headers, h1 wrappers, and stat bars. Do not reduce it to 10% presence; it belongs at 40-60%.

rules.name: The No-Thin Rule
rules.body: Weight 200 is prohibited. Body runs at 400 minimum; nothing thinner exists in the system.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Nothing gets a shadow unless it needs to be readable against the background image. Add shadow-sm for clickable elements, shadow-md for content containers. No intermediate values.

dos: Do use Tatami Gold (#dcb67d) as a structural background for every header, h1 wrapper, and stat chip.
Do reserve Shiso Green exclusively for active states, selected tabs, and focus rings.
Do keep translucent surfaces at rgba(255,255,255,0.92).
Do use scale(0.97) on :active for all clickable nav elements and pagination buttons.
Do size content columns to min(70%, 720px) on desktop, 92% on mobile.
Do use Poppins weight 700/600/500/400. No weight below 400.
donts: Don't use Shiso Green for decorative fills or non-interactive elements.
Don't add border-left side-stripe accents to table rows or cards.
Don't apply gradient text or background-clip: text effects.
Don't hardcode width: 70% without a min() cap.
Don't use the broad p {} selector in shared CSS.
Don't treat this as a dark-mode product — surfaces are warm translucent white.
